clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for material, construction, workmanship, finish, performance and testing for glass fibre reinforced polyester resin (GRP) pourflush type squatting pans conact moulded as well as compression moulded. SUMMARY OF IS  11246 : 1992  GLASS FIBRE REINFORCED POLYESTER RESIN (GRP) SQUATTING PANS (First Revision) * Glass fibre rovings for reinforcement of  polyester and epoxide resin systems (first revision) + Glass fibre  chopped strand mat for the reinforcement of  epoxy, phenolic and polyester resin systems (first revision)

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material

clauses.title: Glass Fibre
clauses.text: 2.1 Glass Fibre — As per  IS  11320: 1997* and   IS 11551 : 1996+ Low alkali glass with glass content of the laminate minimum 30 percent by weight. FIG. 1 SQUATING  PAN TABLE 1  FUNCTIONAL DIMENSIONS DESCRIPTION REF IN FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS (mm) (1) (2) (3) Width of front profile (semi-circle) A 125 Wdith at rear profile (semi-circle) B 200 Vertical drop in front wall of pan C 70 Rear of back wall of the pan nclination to horizontal off D 6-8° set to trap opening Length of top opening E 425 Slope of bottom of pan F 25-28° Overall depth of pan (see Note) G 320 Length of entry of squatting pan into the P-trap H 40 Min Dia at entry from sqattig pan to P-trap J 77, ID Projected bend of rim all-round K 20-25 Notes — 1 Dimension C, G and H are for general guidance. 2 Tolerance + 4% for all dimensions of 50 mm and above.

clauses.title: Polyster Resin
clauses.text: 2.2. Polyster Resin — Unsaturated polyster resin shall be isopthalic type

clauses.title: Sheet Moulding Compound (SMC)
clauses.text: 2.3. Sheet Moulding Compound (SMC) -  Shall be of low profile grade and shall consist of glass fibre reinforcements pre-impregnated with filled unsaturated polyester resin system in sheet form.

clauses.title: Surface Coat
clauses.text: 2.4Surface Coat a)  Gel coat. b)  Polyurethane resin coat

clauses.title: Thickness and Mass
clauses.text: 3. Thickness and Mass

clauses.title: Thickness
clauses.text: 3.1 Thickness i) With gel coat  — 2.0  mm, Min ii) With PU coat  — 1.8  mm, Min At the point of additional reinfore cement, that is rim and bottom outlet, the minimum thickness shall be 2.8 mm with gel coat and 2.6 mm with PU coat.

clauses.title: Mass – The minimum
clauses.text: 3.2 Mass - The minimum mass of hand laid pans shall be 750 gm and for sheet moulding compound (SMC) shall be 900 gms.

clauses.title: Performance requirements
clauses.text: 4. Performance requirements

clauses.title: Warpage
clauses.text: 4.1 Warpage — Feeler guage of 4mm shall not slide under it without application of force.

clauses.title: Thickness – See  3.1
clauses.text: 4.2 Thickness - See  3.1

clauses.title: Impact Resistance
clauses.text: 4.3 Impact Resistance — Shall not show any cracks in the  surface coat.

clauses.title: Crazing
clauses.text: 4.4 Crazing  - Shall not show cracks or  crazing after oven test.

clauses.title: Water Absorption
clauses.text: 4.5 Water Absorption — Shall not absorb water in excess of 0.5 percent.

clauses.title: Gel Coat
clauses.text: 4.6 Gel Coat — Shall not be less than 0.20mm thick and not more than 0.40mm thick.

clauses.title: Reistance of hydrochloric acid/uric
clauses.text: 4.7 Reistance of hydrochloric acid/uric  acid: there shall be no discoloration and exposure of glass fibre.

clauses.title: Hardness
clauses.text: 4.8 Hardness — Minimum 30 points for gel coated  20 points for Pu coats or Barcol impressor.

clauses.title: Scratch Resistance
clauses.text: 4.9 Scratch Resistance — Shall withstand 40,000 cycles in scrub test.

clauses.title: Ink Test
clauses.text: 4.10 Ink Test - Ink stains and defects mentioned under 5.3 of the standard shall not be permitted. For detailed information, refer to IS  11246 : 1992 Specification for glass fibre reinforced polyester resin (FRP) squatting pans (first revision).
